summary: Batch data-export utility for branch migration. Reads the five normalized CardDemo master files (customer, account, cross-reference, transaction, card) and writes a single multi-record export file, stamping each run with a generated timestamp and counting the records exported per entity. A straightforward ETL/migration extract with little business logic.

paragraphs.name: MAIN-PARA
paragraphs.pseudocode: Initialize (timestamp + open files), then export customers, accounts, cross-references, transactions and cards in turn, and finalize. Return.

paragraphs.name: 1000-INITIALIZE
paragraphs.pseudocode: Generate the export timestamp, open all input master files and the export output file, and display the export date/time.

paragraphs.name: 1050-GENERATE-TIMESTAMP
paragraphs.pseudocode: Accept the current date (YYYYMMDD) and time, format them as YYYY-MM-DD and HH:MM:SS, and build a 26-character export timestamp.
paragraphs.notes: Timestamp builder using ACCEPT FROM DATE/TIME.

paragraphs.name: 1100-OPEN-FILES
paragraphs.pseudocode: Open the customer, account, cross-reference, transaction and card files for input and the export file for output; abend if any open fails (checked via 88-level status conditions).

paragraphs.name: 2000-EXPORT-CUSTOMERS
paragraphs.pseudocode: Read customer records until EOF, writing a customer export record for each; display the count exported.

paragraphs.name: 2100-READ-CUSTOMER-RECORD
paragraphs.pseudocode: Read the next customer record; on a non-OK/non-EOF status, abend.
branches: IF NOT WS-CUSTOMER-OK AND NOT WS-CUSTOMER-EOF -> abend

paragraphs.name: 2200-CREATE-CUSTOMER-EXP-REC
paragraphs.pseudocode: Build a customer export record (with the run timestamp) and write it to the export file; count it.

paragraphs.name: 3000-EXPORT-ACCOUNTS
paragraphs.pseudocode: Read account records until EOF, writing an account export record for each; display the count.

paragraphs.name: 3100-READ-ACCOUNT-RECORD
paragraphs.pseudocode: Read the next account record; abend on a non-OK/non-EOF status.
branches: IF NOT WS-ACCOUNT-OK AND NOT WS-ACCOUNT-EOF -> abend

paragraphs.name: 3200-CREATE-ACCOUNT-EXP-REC
paragraphs.pseudocode: Build and write an account export record; count it.

paragraphs.name: 4000-EXPORT-XREFS
paragraphs.pseudocode: Read cross-reference records until EOF, writing an xref export record for each; display the count.

paragraphs.name: 4100-READ-XREF-RECORD
paragraphs.pseudocode: Read the next cross-reference record; abend on a non-OK/non-EOF status.
branches: IF NOT WS-XREF-OK AND NOT WS-XREF-EOF -> abend

paragraphs.name: 4200-CREATE-XREF-EXP-REC
paragraphs.pseudocode: Build and write a cross-reference export record; count it.

paragraphs.name: 5000-EXPORT-TRANSACTIONS
paragraphs.pseudocode: Read transaction records until EOF, writing a transaction export record for each; display the count.

paragraphs.name: 5100-READ-TRANSACTION-RECORD
paragraphs.pseudocode: Read the next transaction record; abend on a non-OK/non-EOF status.
branches: IF NOT WS-TRANSACTION-OK AND NOT WS-TRANSACTION-EOF -> abend

paragraphs.name: 5200-CREATE-TRANSACTION-EXP-REC
paragraphs.pseudocode: Build and write a transaction export record; count it.

paragraphs.name: 5500-EXPORT-CARDS
paragraphs.pseudocode: Read card records until EOF, writing a card export record for each; display the count.

paragraphs.name: 5600-READ-CARD-RECORD
paragraphs.pseudocode: Read the next card record; abend on a non-OK/non-EOF status.
branches: IF NOT WS-CARD-OK AND NOT WS-CARD-EOF -> abend

paragraphs.name: 5700-CREATE-CARD-EXP-REC
paragraphs.pseudocode: Build and write a card export record; count it.

paragraphs.name: 6000-FINALIZE
paragraphs.pseudocode: Close all files and display the total records exported per entity (export summary/trailer).

paragraphs.name: 9999-ABEND-PROGRAM
paragraphs.pseudocode: Display an abend message and terminate the program abnormally.
